uncertain: カイト = 'Kite' (coined): a cutscene-only unit listed among the Arksaber/Insaraum units (Diem-Sar, Diamd, Sapphiada, Emeraldan); not in the glossary and no English source found. Could instead be 'Kaito' (Jigoku's name piece) if it is named after a person.
サフィアーダ = 'Sapphiada' from the glossary research entry (glossary key is spelled サフィーアダ, status proposed); the brief's katakana サフィアーダ matches ja.wikipedia.

Angels keep the glossary's 'the Fourth/Seventh Angel' with lowercase 'the' (as the other Angel cells already do); shorts 'the 4th Angel' / 'the 7th Angel'. The whole Angel family might read better without 'the' as unit names.
エヴァンゲリオン改２号機γ short 'EVA-02γ Kai' (the 'EVA Unit-02γ Kai' pattern is 16 chars); keeps the glossary's γ, differs in shape from 'EVA Unit-01' / 'EVA Unit-08'.

Shorts that drop the title/type: 'Vildark' (Dimensional General), 'Varna' (Dimensional Beast). 'ArcGurrenLagann' drops hyphen and space to fit, like the sibling 'SG GurrenLagann'. 'Lancelot Front.', 'Guren SEITEN', 'MP Asclepus', 'Trans. Shuttle', 'Inf. Justice' coined to fit 15.

Non-glossary names used: Clop-class (CCA official), ZAKU Warrior (SEED Destiny official caps), Infinite Justice Gundam, Gold SUMO (glossary スモー = SUMO), Mordred, Sutherland Sieg, Zangetsu, Eternal, VF-11, Transport Shuttle, Gepelnitch Ship (ゲペルニッチ艦), Light Sphere (光球, Jigoku's English), Virgola Unit 1/2 (バルゴラⅠ/Ⅱ号機; wiki may write 'Virgola 1/2').
